in_sanskrit.name: Asadul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Asadul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Asadul is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Asa', meaning 'Lord', and 'Dul', meaning 'of the Gods'. This name is a reverence to Lord Indra, the King of Gods, and is believed to bring strength, power, and divine blessings.
